objective.title: Install an AI-first control plane and run the first governed operating loop
success_criteria: one real task runs through COO -> Governor -> specialist -> Documentation
the queue stays current in active-work.json
Task Board.md is rendered from the queue
telemetry captures routing, execution, acceptance, and sync events

tasks.title: Install the machine-readable AI control plane and generated board
tasks.next_step: Use the control plane on live work instead of treating it as architecture-only.
tasks.done_when: `05 AI Control Plane/` exists, validates, and `Task Board.md` is rendered from it.

tasks.title: Add telemetry, validation, and tests for the HQ runtime
tasks.next_step: Start writing real events from live work into `.hq/telemetry/`.
tasks.done_when: Validation passes, telemetry events can be written, and tests cover the new runtime surfaces.

tasks.title: Run one real company task through COO -> Governor -> specialist -> Documentation
tasks.next_step: Pick a real founder request and execute it through the new control plane without bypasses.
tasks.done_when: One task completes with queue state, acceptance, board sync, and telemetry events.

tasks.title: Calibrate Governor approval thresholds and external action policy
tasks.next_step: Resolve open decisions about budget, external sends, deploy authority, and connector write access.
tasks.done_when: `03 Notes/Open Decisions.md` is reduced and `operating-policies.json` reflects approved thresholds.

tasks.title: Connect email, calendar, and CRM writes only behind explicit Governor-reviewed connectors
tasks.next_step: Do not connect external write surfaces until thresholds, logging, and rollback rules are agreed.
tasks.done_when: At least one external connector is enabled with audit logging, review, and rollback notes.
